question: Does the exact owner-adopted full comparison contract satisfy its finite definition obligations without changing the model?
method: Independently derive a closed formula for arbitrary comparable indices, check it against all adjacent compositions on bounded declared samples, and review all-index totality, symmetry, algebra/norm/support and root obligations. Kernel-check parameterized arithmetic and pullback facts with precise unencoded scope.

closed_form.inputs: coarse (r,h,N), fine (s,k,M), D=2^(s-r), H=2^(k-h), b=H^2, P=K_s/K_r, A=P^(-1) mod K_r
closed_form.occupation: For coarse z<t, ell'_z=floor(S_(b*(z+1)-1)/D)-floor(S_(b*z-1)/D). At t=|V_coarse|-1, ell'_t=Q_r-floor(S_(b*t-1)/D). S_-1=0.
closed_form.other: j'_z=floor(j_(b*z)/D), n'_z=A*n_(b*z) mod K_r; u'_e=A times the fine axial path sum of length H modulo K_r.
closed_form.scope: Alternative formula to prove equivalent to the approved maps, not a replacement definition or new proposal.

primary: Approved backend compositions in all six axis orders, all interleavings at the named (2,1,1) corner, full right inverses, source gauge transport, and complete root labels at the declared states.
independent: Non-importing direct-formula implementation, direct charge-token grouping, independent root updates and endpoint assignments, coordinate-distance rigidity cross-check and full normative all-index audit.
hostile_controls: Ordinary phase rounding instead of additive projection
Pointwise occupation floor instead of prefix carry
Drop unmatched root channels or collapse K=2 inverse labels
Replace full sup norm by Gibbs average
Confuse finite support stabilization with generator intertwining
scope_limit: The all-index proof is written mathematics supplemented by parameterized Lean lemmas, not inferred from sample counts. No full-state-space computational exhaustion except the inherited smallest coarse fixture. No external human referee.
completion: PASS only if every definition obligation is discharged at its stated scope; any contradiction is recorded against these exact bytes without repair. Missing definition or proof yields HOLD with one precise missing item. No new generator calculation.
non_claims: No T054 gate or C6 tier change
No Gibbs projectivity, generator agreement or limiting core theorem
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, QFT, GR, continuum, gravity or TOE
